show.description: Billionaire’s Tallaq is a gripping romance-drama of mistaken identities, betrayal, and second chances. Vaidehi, a struggling village girl, unknowingly becomes the secret wife of billionaire heir Armaan Sharma after saving his life, only for him to abandon her and flee abroad. Five years later, when fate brings them face to face again, lies, misunderstandings, and love collide—forcing them into a dangerous game of marriage, divorce, and destiny.
